Where Krisp struggles with heavy accents and fast speech despite its accent conversion feature, Circleback's advanced AI models handle diverse speaking patterns much better. The platform delivers consistently accurate transcriptions regardless of accent, speaking speed, or meeting dynamics, so no important details get lost. Features like custom vocabulary help ensure even industry-specific terms are captured correctly. Krisp processes audio locally to remove background noise, echoes, and other audio issues, which helps improve transcript accuracy.
